title: Stiff and wrinkly
text:
Stiff and wrinkly. While the headline is telling, it doesn't convey just how wrinkly this bottom sheet comes out of the dryer. Maybe it's just the dark gray color and the shadows (meaning maybe wrinkles in lighter colors sheets aren't as noticeable), but the wrinkles are terrible looking to me. And I'm a messy person by nature, so I don't usually care about such things. I really don't.
I also found the sheet to be not smooth and rather stiff. I washed and dried in a heated dryer a couple hoping that would help loosing the threads a little, but it really hasn't. I can't say I'd recommend this one knowing Amazon has better options available.
Hope this review was helpful
